paragraphs.text: translated by
1. EVEN as an archer shoots afar his arrow, offer the laud to him with meet adornment.
paragraphs.original: अस्तेव सु प्रतरं लायमस्यन्भूषन्निव प्र भरा स्तोममस्मै ।
paragraphs.translit: asteva su prataraṃ lāyamasyanbhūṣanniva pra bharā stomamasmai |

paragraphs.text: Quell with your voice the wicked's voice, O sages. Singer, make Indra rest beside the Soma.
paragraphs.original: वाचा विप्रास्तरत वाचमर्यो नि रामय जरितः सोम इन्द्रम्
paragraphs.translit: vācā viprāstarata vācamaryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram

paragraphs.text: 2. Draw thy Friend to thee like a cow at milking: O Singer, wake up Indra as a lover.
paragraphs.original: दोहेन गामुप शिक्षा सखायं प्र बोधय जरितर्जारमिन्द्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: dohena gāmupa śikṣā sakhāyaṃ pra bodhaya jaritarjāramindram |

paragraphs.text: Make thou the Hero haste to give us riches even as a vessel filled brimful with treasure.
paragraphs.original: कोशं न पूर्णं वसुना न्यृष्टमा च्यावय मघदेयाय शूरम्
paragraphs.translit: kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭamā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram

paragraphs.text: 3. Why, Maghavan, do they call thee Bounteous; Giver? Quicken me: thou, I hear, art he who quickens.
paragraphs.original: किमङ्ग त्वा मघवन्भोजमाहुः शिशीहि मा शिशयं त्वा शृणोमि ।
paragraphs.translit: kimaṅga tvā maghavanbhojamāhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi |

paragraphs.text: Sakra, let my intelligence be active, and bring us luck that finds great wealth, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: अप्नस्वती मम धीरस्तु शक्र वसुविदं भगमिन्द्रा भरा नः
paragraphs.translit: apnasvatī mama dhīrastu śakra vasuvidaṃ bhagamindrā bharā naḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Standing, in battle for their rights, together, the people, Indra, in the fray invoke thee.
paragraphs.original: त्वां जना ममसत्येष्विन्द्र संतस्थाना वि ह्वयन्ते समीके ।
paragraphs.translit: tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣvindra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke |

paragraphs.text: Him who brings gifts the Hero makes his comrade: with him who pours no juice he seeks not friendship.
paragraphs.original: अत्रा युजं कृणुते यो हविष्मान्नासुन्वता सख्यं वष्टि शूरः
paragraphs.translit: atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmānnāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Whoso with plenteous food for him expresses strong Somas as much quickly-coming treasure,
paragraphs.original: धनं न स्यन्द्रं बहुलं यो अस्मै तीव्रान्सोमाँ आसुनोति प्रयस्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: dhanaṃ na syandraṃ bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrānsomām̐ āsunoti prayasvān |

paragraphs.text: For him he overthrows in early morning his swift well-weaponed foes, and slays the tyrant.
paragraphs.original: तस्मै शत्रून्सुतुकान्प्रातरह्नो नि स्वष्ट्रान्युवति हन्ति वृत्रम्
paragraphs.translit: tasmai śatrūnsutukānprātarahno ni svaṣṭrānyuvati hanti vṛtram

paragraphs.text: 6. He unto whom we offer praises, Indra, Maghavan, who hath joined to ours his wishes,-
paragraphs.original: यस्मिन्वयं दधिमा शंसमिन्द्रे यः शिश्राय मघवा काममस्मे ।
paragraphs.translit: yasminvayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsamindre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmamasme |

paragraphs.text: Before him even afar the foe must tremble: low before him must bow all human glories.
paragraphs.original: आराच्चित्सन्भयतामस्य शत्रुर्न्यस्मै द्युम्ना जन्या नमन्ताम्
paragraphs.translit: ārāccitsanbhayatāmasya śatrurnyasmai dyumnā janyā namantām

paragraphs.text: 7. With thy fierce bolt, O God invoked of many, drive to a distance from afar the foeman.
paragraphs.original: आराच्छत्रुमप बाधस्व दूरमुग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन ।
paragraphs.translit: ārācchatrumapa bādhasva dūramugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, give us wealth in corn and cattle, and make thy singer's prayer gain strength and riches.
paragraphs.original: अस्मे धेहि यवमद्गोमदिन्द्र कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम्
paragraphs.translit: asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām

paragraphs.text: 8. Indra, the swallower of strong libations rich in the boons they bring, the potent Somas,
paragraphs.original: प्र यमन्तर्वृषसवासो अग्मन्तीव्राः सोमा बहुलान्तास इन्द्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: pra yamantarvṛṣasavāso agmantīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram |

paragraphs.text: He, Maghavan, will not restrict his bounty he brings much wealth unto the Soma-presser.
paragraphs.original: नाह दामानं मघवा नि यंसन्नि सुन्वते वहति भूरि वामम्
paragraphs.translit: nāha dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsanni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam

paragraphs.text: 9. Yea, by superior play he wins advantage, when he, a gambler, piles his gains in season.
paragraphs.original: उत प्रहामतिदीव्या जयाति कृतं यच्छ्वघ्नी विचिनोति काले ।
paragraphs.translit: uta prahāmatidīvyā jayāti kṛtaṃ yacchvaghnī vicinoti kāle |

paragraphs.text: Celestial-natured, he o'erwhelms with riches the devotee who keeps not back his treasure.
paragraphs.original: यो देवकामो न धना रुणद्धि समित्तं राया सृजति स्वधावान्
paragraphs.translit: yo devakāmo na dhanā ruṇaddhi samittaṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān

paragraphs.text: 10. O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
paragraphs.original: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |

paragraphs.text: May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
paragraphs.original: वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम
paragraphs.translit: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema

paragraphs.text: 11. Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners!
paragraphs.original: * बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः । इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु
paragraphs.translit: * bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu

paragraphs.text: May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
